title: asymmetric check_admin_addr signatures between transit (Option) and reader (Result)
description: transit/src/config.rs:634 check_admin_addr returns Option<String> (a warning string); reader/src/config.rs:515 returns Result<(),String>. Transit's version returns None (no warning) when allow_non_loopback=true even without a bearer token — but start_admin_server still rejects that combination. A contributor adding admin support to a third daemon will copy one of these inconsistent patterns. The allow_non_loopback flag in transit config is confusing: it suppresses the config-level warning but the server's fail-closed guard still fires. Unify: both should return Result<(),String> and enforce the same rule (non-loopback requires bearer token, period).
